cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Warmly Enforced
cards.instruction: Remain kind and welcoming while enforcing increasingly restrictive rules without exception.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're so glad you're staying. The guest bed is yours; just no food upstairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. I'll have my breakfast downstairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. After nine, please; we keep the kitchen quiet before then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My train's at eight. Could I take a banana?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd love to feed you. Breakfast stays in the kitchen. I'll find you a later train so you can eat at nine.

reason: A retains every rule but takes responsibility for finding a workable later train, instead of asking B to absorb all accommodation.
